nodes.statement: Fix source semantic-calibration C, reporting target-style validation V, genuinely nonreporting target T, selected H, marker M, audit endpoint J, audit inclusion A, actual-use U=1, bearer class, interval and complete application signature.
nodes.scope: Selected familiar-continuity marker validation only; not basal-experience admission.
nodes.quantifier: For every proposed R202 validation or transport application.

nodes.statement: The unlabelled target supplies only m_T=P_T(M=1|U=1), with latent prevalence and two H-class marker rates unspecified.
nodes.scope: One binary marker and selected binary H coordinate in T.
nodes.quantifier: For every target domain lacking endpoint or equivalent H-stratifying evidence.

nodes.statement: Every nondegenerate unlabelled marker marginal is compatible with both positive and negative H-class marker contrasts, so neither target direction nor R201 class-specific drift budgets are identified from that marginal alone.
nodes.scope: Binary mixture model under only probability validity.
nodes.quantifier: For every m in (0,1) and a permitted positive displacement d.

nodes.statement: Audit inclusion is prospectively assigned and independent of H, M and J conditional on the frozen validation domain and actual U=1, or a justified selection model replaces this condition.
nodes.quantifier: For every use of the audit sample to represent V.

nodes.statement: Endpoint semantics and response-key direction are fixed independently, with a=P(J=1|H=1) and c=P(J=1|H=0) independently calibrated and a>c.
nodes.scope: One endpoint in V and the selected H meaning.

nodes.statement: Within V and actual U=1, endpoint error is conditionally independent of marker M given H, or departures receive an explicit residual sensitivity bound.
nodes.quantifier: For both H classes in every inversion application.

nodes.statement: Validation formulae condition on actual U=1; telemetry, perturbation, bypass and audit success remain evidence E_U and cannot be substituted for U without a further error model.
nodes.quantifier: For every bearer, episode and route-use claim.

nodes.statement: Under the full audit interface, latent prevalence and both validation-domain H-class marker rates are recovered exactly from the audited M,J joint law and independent endpoint error rates.
nodes.quantifier: For every instance satisfying all simultaneous inversion premises and positivity.

nodes.statement: A reporting target-style audit validates at most C-to-V; any claim in genuinely nonreporting T still requires explicit V-to-T class-conditional transport or a justified same-domain missingness design.
nodes.scope: The fixed C,V,T chain and selected target only.

nodes.statement: Equal target marginals permit opposite directions; a=c makes the audit matrix singular; and H-dependent audit selection can equalize audit prevalence across populations with different true prevalence.
nodes.scope: Declared binary mixture and audit models.
nodes.quantifier: There exist exact rational witnesses for each omitted premise.

rules.statement: Construct equal-weight class-conditionals m-d,m+d and their swap.
rules.binding: One T,H,M,U=1 and the same observed marginal are retained across the two rival models.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Additional independently justified target information may shrink the identified set but must be represented explicitly.

rules.statement: Invert the two-by-two endpoint misclassification equations with a-c nonzero and retain actual U=1.
rules.binding: One V,H,M,J,A,U=1, endpoint-error matrix and audited joint law are retained.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: If endpoint errors are differential or audit selection is nonignorable, report a sensitivity set rather than point identification.

rules.statement: Separate validation-domain identification from the remaining no-report-domain transport step.
rules.binding: One declared C-to-V-to-T chain, target meaning, marker event and actual-use interface are retained.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: A genuine same-domain randomized missing-endpoint design may collapse V and T, but that equality must be established rather than named.

rules.statement: Evaluate exact orientation, singular-endpoint and selective-audit witness pairs.
rules.binding: Each witness retains one declared observed law while varying only the hidden premise under attack.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Stronger sampling or endpoint assumptions can exclude a witness only when independently supported.

context_links.statement: The audit interface neither proves nor replaces C1.
Report, audit inclusion, endpoint reliability and transport are not basal-experience requirements.
A reporting validation domain does not silently totalize a report measure over nonreporting T.
Audit or bypass evidence does not supply actual trace continuation and consumer use.
R201 drift budgets cannot be estimated from an unlabelled target marker marginal alone.
